(7) The white cat is seen again, this time on a larger tan cushion, curled up very tightly, looking like a ball of rice. (8) Extreme close-up of the white cat's underside and paws, showing pink skin and soft fur while it sleeps. (9) The screen transitions to a solid pink background with white Chinese and English text for the brand logo.
